test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ENTER' is coded as "FOTGT and 'DICEY' is coded as 'EJCGA'. What is the 'CHILD' in the given code language?
solution:
The logic followed is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e820d3b929240a6899edfe169fae6274b430efad8398a93b2fd62313f534e356.png] 

'ENTER' is coded as "FOTGT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42acc33e66a6751c526d6b0b23797655c627f96d7865de6d27306c95c459ac76.png] 

'DICEY' is coded as 'EJCGA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a75812a7c79280b0a216b63035cb35df5eb58f31e005a8e8a522b475ab89431.png] 

Similarly, for CHILD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f94f89e73a7f89d4cdec4f7fe5bfbb64949f4f6122a04d3800a78c85b8b516.png] 

So, '**CHILD**' will be coded as **'DIINF'.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
